questionnaire.name: Fantasy Profile
questionnaire.purpose: A private questionnaire for noticing what kinds of fantasies, feelings, and dynamics you respond to.
questionnaire.prompt: As a fantasy, how does this land for you?
questionnaire.adultScope: All partner and group scenarios involve people who are 18 or older. Any observation scenario assumes consent.
questionnaire.disclaimer: An appealing scenario is not the same as consent, intent, identity, or something you want to do in real life.

dimensions.label: Surrender
dimensions.description: Letting go of control and not having to decide what happens next.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where yielding, following, or not having to decide is especially charged.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean fantasies are more appealing when personal agency remains central.

dimensions.label: Authority & responsibility
dimensions.description: Taking the lead, making decisions, and being responsible for how the moment unfolds.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where taking the lead and carrying responsibility are part of the appeal.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean being responsible for directing another person is not an important fantasy driver.

dimensions.label: Helplessness & vulnerability
dimensions.description: Feeling exposed, unable to change the moment, or having someone else in that position.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where vulnerability or inability to change the moment heightens intensity.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean fantasies are more appealing when vulnerability remains limited or easily reversible.

dimensions.label: Trust & emotional safety
dimensions.description: The charge that comes from feeling safe enough to drop your guard completely.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies whose intensity depends on feeling deeply trusted, trusting, or emotionally held.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean trust is assumed rather than a primary source of fantasy charge.

dimensions.label: Anticipation & denial
dimensions.description: Waiting, wanting, suspense, and having gratification delayed.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where waiting or being kept wanting is part of the pleasure.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean direct gratification is more appealing than prolonged suspense or denial.

dimensions.label: Fear & adrenaline
dimensions.description: The rush of uncertainty, pursuit, danger-like tension, or adrenaline in fantasy.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where a racing-heart sense of threat or uncertainty is part of the appeal.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean fear-like tension reduces rather than increases fantasy appeal.

dimensions.label: Pain & physical intensity
dimensions.description: Pain or overwhelming physical sensation being part of what makes a fantasy intense.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where pain or intense physical sensation becomes a central focus.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean physical intensity is more appealing when it stays below the threshold of pain.

dimensions.label: Humiliation & embarrassment
dimensions.description: Embarrassment, lowered status, or feeling personally exposed.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where embarrassment or being made to feel small creates erotic charge.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean dignity, affirmation, or emotional neutrality is more important in fantasy.

dimensions.label: Praise & approval
dimensions.description: Praise, approval, admiration, and the emotional hit of being told you’re doing well.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where praise or approval from a partner has unusually strong emotional impact.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean external approval is not a major source of fantasy intensity.

dimensions.label: Being desired & attention
dimensions.description: Being unmistakably wanted, or giving someone else that kind of focused attention.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where focused desire and attention are central to the charge.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean being the center of desire is less important than other dynamics.

dimensions.label: Possession & belonging
dimensions.description: Ownership, claiming and belonging.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where a sense of being mine or belonging to someone is especially powerful.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean closeness is more appealing without possessive or claiming themes.

dimensions.label: Tenderness & care
dimensions.description: Care, comfort, affection, and looking after someone during or after intensity.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where care, soothing, or affectionate attention is a major part of the emotional payoff.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean tenderness is secondary to other fantasy drivers.

dimensions.label: Control & permission
dimensions.description: Who gets to decide, who has to ask, and whose permission matters.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where explicit decision power or permission creates much of the charge.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean control is more appealing when choices remain shared or informal.

dimensions.label: Rules, ritual & structure
dimensions.description: Rules, rituals, repeated routines, and the appeal of doing things a particular way.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where structure, ritual, or rule-following is exciting in its own right.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean spontaneity is more appealing than formal rules or repeated structure.

dimensions.label: Service & usefulness
dimensions.description: Being useful to someone, serving them, or being on the receiving end of focused service.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where usefulness, attending to needs, or being served carries special meaning.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean service roles add little to fantasy appeal.

dimensions.label: Restraint & confinement
dimensions.description: Restricted movement, being held in place, or controlling someone else’s movement.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where physical restriction or inability to move freely is central.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean freedom of movement is important to fantasy enjoyment.

dimensions.label: Objectification & use
dimensions.description: Being treated, or treating someone, more like a body, object, or function within the fantasy.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where personhood temporarily recedes behind being used, positioned, or reduced to a function.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean mutual recognition and personhood are important to maintaining fantasy appeal.

dimensions.label: Exposure & being seen
dimensions.description: Being revealed, displayed, or visibly exposed to consenting people.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where being visibly exposed or placed on display creates the charge.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean privacy is more appealing than being exposed or displayed.

dimensions.label: Watching & observation
dimensions.description: Watching someone closely, or knowing that someone is closely watching you.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where watching or being watched is a meaningful part of the experience.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean direct participation matters more than observation.

dimensions.label: Sensory focus & alteration
dimensions.description: Changing what someone can see, hear, feel, or process so certain sensations take over.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where altered sensory awareness becomes the main route to intensity.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean ordinary sensory awareness is preferable to restriction or overload.

dimensions.label: Role & identity change
dimensions.description: Taking on another identity, character, status, name, or social role while remaining physically yourself.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect scenarios where becoming a different version of yourself through identity or social role is part of the appeal.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean changing identity or social role adds little when your physical form stays the same.

dimensions.label: Struggle & competition
dimensions.description: Pursuit, resistance, wrestling, competition, and raw physical struggle.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where struggle, pursuit, resistance, or winning and losing create the charge.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean cooperation is more appealing than competition or physical struggle.

dimensions.label: Taboo & transgression
dimensions.description: The thrill of crossing a social boundary or entering a forbidden-feeling scenario.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where forbiddenness or social transgression is itself a source of excitement.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean taboo or rule-breaking themes reduce fantasy appeal.

dimensions.label: Novelty & experimentation
dimensions.description: Newness, surprise, changing things up, and imagining something unfamiliar.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies driven by curiosity, surprise, and unfamiliar possibilities.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean familiar patterns are more appealing than novelty for its own sake.

dimensions.label: Group & multi-partner dynamics
dimensions.description: The social and erotic energy of fantasies involving several consenting people.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where attention, desire, or interaction among several people is central.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean one-to-one scenarios are more appealing than group dynamics.

dimensions.label: Focused objects, materials & body details
dimensions.description: A particular material, object, garment, sensation, or body detail becoming the main focus.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect fantasies where a concrete object, texture, sensation, or body detail carries concentrated appeal.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean broader relational or situational themes matter more than a specific focus.

dimensions.label: Romance
dimensions.description: Being in love, being loved, or sharing a romantic bond that is central to the charge.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect scenarios where romantic attachment itself matters, beyond care, trust, praise, desire, or belonging.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean affection, safety, desire, or intensity can matter without romance being central.

dimensions.label: Transformation
dimensions.description: Literal physical changes to your body or someone else's body, including changes beyond ordinary physical limits.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect scenarios where physical change itself, the changed form, or the process of changing is part of the appeal.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean identity or role changes are more appealing when the body itself stays physically the same.

dimensions.label: Becoming huge
dimensions.description: Growing to an enormous size, or being drawn to dramatic differences involving someone gigantic.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect an interest in gigantic size or extreme size difference even when dominance is not the point.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean growing gigantic or interacting across that size difference adds little to the appeal.

dimensions.label: Being tiny
dimensions.description: Shrinking to an extremely small size, or being drawn to dramatic differences involving someone tiny.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect an interest in tiny size or extreme size difference even when helplessness is not the point.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean shrinking or interacting across that size difference adds little to the appeal.

dimensions.label: Animal transformation
dimensions.description: Literally becoming an animal or developing animal features, rather than simply acting animal-like.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect an interest in the physical change into an animal form itself.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean pet roles, instinctive behavior, or costumes can stand apart from literal animal change.

dimensions.label: Mind control
dimensions.description: Thoughts or actions being controlled because the mind itself has been altered, rather than because someone has authority.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect scenarios where literal mental control or inability to resist because the mind has changed is central.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean authority, permission, or surrender can be appealing without literal control of thoughts or actions.

dimensions.label: Nonconsent
dimensions.description: The imagined lack of consent itself being part of the appeal, separate from helplessness, struggle, restraint, or surrender.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect scenarios where consent being overridden is itself part of what creates the charge.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean helplessness, resistance, surrender, or power can appeal while understood permission remains important.

dimensions.label: Monsters & supernatural beings
dimensions.description: Being drawn to monsters, supernatural beings, artificial beings, or other characters that do not exist in ordinary life.
dimensions.positiveInterpretation: Stronger positive evidence may reflect scenarios where the nonhuman, supernatural, or impossible nature of a character is part of the appeal.
dimensions.negativeInterpretation: Weaker or negative evidence may mean unusual appearance, fear, or power can matter without the character being nonhuman or supernatural.

suggestionRules.label: Power exchange
suggestionRules.summary: Your answers suggest you may enjoy fantasies where one person leads and the other gives up some control.

suggestionRules.label: Service / protocol
suggestionRules.summary: You may enjoy fantasies built around serving, being useful, following rules, or having a clear structure.

suggestionRules.label: Bondage / restraint
suggestionRules.summary: Restricted movement or being physically held in place seems to overlap with some of your stronger themes.

suggestionRules.label: Sensory deprivation
suggestionRules.summary: You may enjoy fantasies where sight, sound, touch, or other senses are reduced, controlled, or intensified.

suggestionRules.label: Impact / pain
suggestionRules.summary: Pain or forceful physical sensation appears to be part of the intensity in some fantasies you responded to.

suggestionRules.label: Orgasm control
suggestionRules.summary: Waiting, permission, timing, or being kept wanting may be part of what appeals to you.

suggestionRules.label: Chastity
suggestionRules.summary: Your answers overlap with some of the themes people often explore through chastity: denial, permission, rules, and belonging.

suggestionRules.label: Humiliation / degradation
suggestionRules.summary: Embarrassment, lowered status, or feeling personally exposed showed up strongly enough to make this worth exploring.

suggestionRules.label: Praise / worship
suggestionRules.summary: Praise, approval, adoration, or concentrated positive attention seems to matter in some of your fantasies.

suggestionRules.label: Objectification
suggestionRules.summary: Some of your answers overlap with fantasies about being used, displayed, positioned, or treated more like an object or function.

suggestionRules.label: Exhibition / observation
suggestionRules.summary: Being watched, being on display, or watching someone else closely showed up in your results.

suggestionRules.label: Multi-partner
suggestionRules.summary: Some of your stronger themes involve the attention and social energy of more than two consenting people.

suggestionRules.label: Roleplay
suggestionRules.summary: Changing roles, identity, status, or character while remaining physically yourself seems to add something for you.

suggestionRules.label: Pet / primal
suggestionRules.summary: Pursuit, resistance, instinctive roles, or raw physical competition showed up in your answers.

suggestionRules.label: Psychological play
suggestionRules.summary: Suspense, vulnerability, fear-like tension, teasing, or uncertainty may be part of the appeal for you.

suggestionRules.label: Relationship dynamics
suggestionRules.summary: Belonging, care, trust, romance, authority, or ongoing structure showed up strongly enough to make relationship-style dynamics worth a look.

suggestionRules.label: Fetish / material interests
suggestionRules.summary: A particular material, garment, texture, sensation, or object may carry more weight for you than the surrounding scenario.

suggestionRules.label: Body-part interests
suggestionRules.summary: A specific body area or physical detail may sometimes become the main focus of attraction in your fantasies.

suggestionRules.label: Romantic connection
suggestionRules.summary: Romantic attachment itself showed up as part of the appeal, separate from care, trust, praise, or sexual desire.
